item.title: Colleagues remember magazine editor killed crossing Richmond street: '23 years old and brilliant'
item.description: A 23-year-old magazine editor was killed by a driver while crossing a downtown Richmond street Monday, leaving colleagues and the community mourning the loss of a promising young journalist.

item.title: How Swim RVA gives Richmond students swimming confidence
item.description: Richmond Public Schools held their middle and high school swim championships Tuesday, marking the culmination of work that began for several swimmers with Swim RVA.

item.title: Ward scores 15 off the bench, VCU downs George Washington 89-75
item.description: Tyrell Ward scored 15 points off of the bench to help lead VCU over George Washington 89-75 on Tuesday night.
